snippet.title: Rhythm Animal Café //  Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859210/Rhythm_Animal_Caf/

Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!

Developed by
Salt Game Studio

In the Bitsummit 13th Summer of Yokai event
